title: Mixed quartic getfu reconstruction
objective: Freeze and implement the next source-faithful PARI 2.17.4 mixed-quartic getfu cut: 4x4 RgM_solve_realimag, integer reconstruction, and exact unit inverse/norm authentication for one frozen quartic, preserving PRECI/LARGE and factored-input semantics.

handoff.summary: Implemented the connected mixed-signature quartic getfu suffix in ordinary Python. For the frozen field x^4-20*x-20, authentic PARI 2.17.4 factored LLL output now passes through exact complex exponentiation, split 4x4 RgM_solve_realimag elimination, integer reconstruction, quartic multiplication-matrix unit/inverse authentication, T2 normalization, and atomic publication. CPython, JavaScript, GMP, and tagged paths return PARI's exact two units, logs, and normalized factor. All backends also exercise fupb_LARGE and fupb_PRECI without publishing partial outputs.
risks: The cut begins at authentic fixarch/LLL outputs; relation-to-unit lattice construction remains an upstream stage.
The harder frozen x^4-20018*x-20034 field still returns fupb_PRECI through 384 bits. Its retry exceeds the current mixed transcendental and packed-real precision corridors.
The exact squared-coordinate T2 comparison matches the frozen integral basis and PARI result; broader rational/nonintegral reconstruction remains outside this cut.
next_steps: Compose this suffix with the resident rank-two unit-lattice selection driver.
Extend mixed mpsincos and packed-real solve capacity before attempting the hard quartic precision retry.
